sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Akimbo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good to see you, brother! I've got a job, and it's one only a master like you can handle. Some Scavs recently intercepted a shipment of plate carriers I had near the lighthouse. Nothing too fancy in there, but those fuckers need to pay for stealing my goods! Only, we're gonna do this one a little differently. I want to see how plate carriers in this price range hold up against different calibers, and now we've got a bunch of idiots walking around wearing them! So we might as well make this test as close to real combat as possible. Take two different caliber rifles on the job and do your part. Just don't shoot 'em in the head, okay? I'm interested in how well the armor holds up! Don't bring the carriers back to me. Once you're done, I'll send my guys to collect the "samples"."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with Ragman to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate any 3 targets with Thorax or Stomach shots using 7.62x39 caliber weapons on Lighthouse (In one raid)
- Eliminate any 3 targets with Thorax or Stomach shots using 7.62x51 caliber weapons on Lighthouse (In one raid)

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Gruppa 99 T30 backpack (MultiCam)
- 1× HighCom Trooper TFO body armor (MultiCam)
- 2× Power cord
"So, you tired from lugging two guns around? But most importantly, you did the job right, as always! I'll send my guys after the armor now. You get some rest. Maybe these tests will even give us some ideas for improving the gear..."
